title: Section-normalized compact-support identity direct image
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$ in the same universe as $E$. Put $R_W=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ with the canonical completed coefficient inverse-image map [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For identity base change on the small pro-etale site, the adjoint coefficient direct-image map [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] followed by restriction along the inverse pullback-identity isomorphism equals $1_{R_W}$. Define ordinaryPushId for module direct image along $1_W$ by the module-sheaf pushforward comparison for that inverse pullback-identity isomorphism, followed by the module pushforward identity unitor. Thus its map on a section over $U$ is restriction along $(U\times_W W\simeq U)^{-1}$. Define integralPushId for the actual ringed derived direct image [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] by deriving this specified ordinary isomorphism and composing the canonical derived-identity localization isomorphisms. No isomorphism is selected from an existence theorem.

proof.text: Reuse IntegralSupportNormalization.ringDirectImageId, the already proved identity coefficient calculation in Sheaf.Paper.IntegralSupportNormalizationData, obtained from the finite quotient characterization of sfCompletedCoefficientMap. It identifies the actual completed coefficient adjunct with the inverse identity direct-image unitor. This is the normalized identity coefficient map used in def-zl-ordinary-open-support-normalization; import all exposes the proved private helper without changing any public interface.

Forget commutativity and evaluate the composite on an arbitrary site object U and section x. The resulting maps are restriction along the pullback-identity hom followed by restriction along its inverse. Contravariant functoriality and the inverse-hom identity make their composite the identity. Extensionality of ring-sheaf morphisms proves identityCoefficient.

Keep ordinaryPushId exactly as the specified pushforwardCongr₂ comparison followed by pushforwardId. Keep integralPushId as its right-derived natural isomorphism followed by the two canonical derived-identity comparisons. No construction or statement changes.
